newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot LPG prices steady, but still pricey.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot LPG prices steady, but still pricey.

text.p: U.S. spot LPG prices were stable in moderate trade ahead of the weekend on Friday, industry sources said.

But prices failed to budge from their lofty levels, despite a slump on NYMEX. Some traders noted that it remains a "seller's market," adding that sellers have been reluctant to part with their barrels.
"There's no incentive for them to move it (barrels) or to discount at all," one Houston-based trader said.
One player suggested that the market, while already strong on tight stocks, may lose its bullish edge if crude oil prices hit a downtrend.
Mont Belvieu propane was assessed at about 51 cents a gallon, while normal butane reportedly traded at 53.25 cents over. Purity ethane held at 32 cent a gallon, they said.
